newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian 88 hits more Alberta foothills gas.
newsitem.headline: Canadian 88 hits more Alberta foothills gas.

text.p: Canadian 88 Energy Corp said on Thursday it successfully drilled a deep horizontal natural gas well in Alberta's foothills.

Canadian 88, which last week announced a major gas discovery at Waterton in southern Alberta, said its Harmatton gas test in the central part of the province encountered a "significant interval of high-quality Elkton pay."
The company has 100-percent interest in the prospect, which is set to be completed and tied into its Olds gas plant in the next 30 days.
The horizontal well was drilled to a true measured depth of 3,337 metres, including a horizontal section of 766 metres, the company said.
Canadian 88 said its production hit a company record 75 million cubic feet of gas and 3,000 barrels of oil and gas liquids per day.
It said it increased its preliminary 1997 production forecast to 140 MMCFD of gas and 5,000 barrels of oil and liquids. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
